claim: In the matching retail DLL, Referee.CheckMatchEnd (0x060050A9) is a parameterless instance method with an exact 168-byte body and exactly one direct DLL caller. It loads MatchMain.inst and first calls Referee.CheckStandByWrestler(); when that helper returns true this method returns. It then returns when MatchMain.isMatchEnd is nonzero and returns when MatchMain.isRoundEnd is nonzero. Otherwise it loads GlobalWork.inst.MatchSetting and calls PlayerMan.inst.GetWrestlerNum_HasRight(). When that returned Int32 is raw zero it calls MatchMain.ProcessMatchEnd_Draw(this.isTwoDownWithExplosion) and returns. For a nonzero count it checks, in exact order: MatchSetting.BattleRoyalKind nonzero -> call Referee.CheckMatchEnd_BattleRoyal; else MatchSetting.VictoryCondition equal raw 4 -> call Referee.CheckMatchEnd_EscapedFromCage; else MatchSetting.isTornadoBattle nonzero -> call Referee.CheckMatchEnd_Tornado; else returned wrestler count equal raw 1 -> call Referee.ProcesskMatchEnd_Normal; otherwise return. FACT-0074 pins the sole direct caller at Referee.UpdateReferee IL+0x007A.
